description: Managed Pub/Sub messaging service for fan-out architectures and notification delivery.

fields.label: Topic Name
fields.why: The logical name used to publish messages and subscribe endpoints (SQS, Lambda, Email).
fields.impact: Changing the name replaces the topic, destroying all active subscriptions.

fields.label: Enable FIFO (First-In-First-Out)
fields.why: Ensures strict message ordering and deduplication for mission-critical pub/sub architectures.
fields.impact: FIFO topics can strictly only be subscribed to by FIFO SQS queues. Topic names must end with '.fifo'.
